text: This code is a correct implementation of the task to return base raised to the non-negative integer exponent exp using recursion. The function power(base, exp) works by repeatedly multiplying the base by the result of the function called with the same base and a decremented exponent, until the exponent reaches 0. At this point, the function returns 1, as any number to the power 0 is defined to be 1. This approach is a straightforward application of the recursive formula for exponentiation, and it correctly handles the base case where the exponent is 0.
